name: MOSS by Nagisa Ichikawa
recipeDetail:
Comments from the Creator
MOSS is a travel recipe that captures deep greens and velvety shadows in a calm, soft tone. It combines color and tone to draw out the scene’s “moisture” under trees, beneath bridges, or on inorganic materials such as brick and concrete.

This recipe achieves a moist, sinking tone that remains clear even under low-light conditions by leaning green toward blue and removing yellow for a subdued palette. Adding a hint of red to the highlights creates a subtle sense of airiness through its complementary relationship with cool greens—a faint transparency shimmering within moistened shadows.

The city’s chaotic hues quiet down; the depth of shadow composes the frame with gentle cohesion. This look blends well with slowly clouding afternoons and the hours when shadows begin to stretch.
